notes.en: [[character:grace]] gets much more value from Shock in her Additional Ability than from Disorder, so she is best in Shock teams. In Disorder teams she works but is a poor fit.
Target stats at level 60: ATK 2,300 to 3,000+, HP 9,500+, DEF 800+, Anomaly Mastery 150 to 190+ and Anomaly Proficiency 350 to 450+.

[[character:remielle]] and [[character:velina]] are strong partners. [[character:yuzuha]] can feel like a must-have to keep Disorders going, and her general buff value is incredibly high. [[character:nangong-yu]] is also a big help.
The W-Engine ranking was calculated with [[character:burnice]] (Flamemaker Shaker) and [[character:yuzuha]] (Kaboom the Cannon). Percentages are relative to her signature.
